{{Top|leg}}
'''Filocards''' were a specialized form of [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] used in banking institutions on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. They identified individuals and kept track of their accounts. An identity verification check was also typically required along with a filocard.
